parameters.label: Monitoring
parameters.tooltip: Master switch. When off, Vigil observes nothing and all checks are idle.

parameters.label: In games
parameters.tooltip: Analyze players during matches (Bed Wars, Duels, SkyWars and similar).

parameters.label: Replays & Atlas
parameters.tooltip: Analyze players while watching Hypixel replays or reviewing Atlas reports.

parameters.label: Pre-game queues
parameters.tooltip: Analyze players while waiting for a match to start. They are always listed under This game; this decides whether checks judge them before the match.

parameters.label: Main lobbies
parameters.tooltip: Analyze players in main lobbies. Lobbies contain parkour, launch pads and other mechanics that resemble cheats.
parameters.warning: Lobby mechanics (launch pads, parkour, double jump) produce movement that resembles cheats.

parameters.label: Analyze yourself
parameters.tooltip: Runs every check on your own player. Use it to calibrate thresholds: anything Vigil reports about you while playing legitimately is a false positive.

parameters.label: Ignore teammates
parameters.tooltip: Skip players on your team (resolved from scoreboard team colors).

parameters.label: Knockback grace
parameters.tooltip: After a player takes damage, movement checks ignore them for this long. Fireballs and TNT can launch players far beyond normal speed.
parameters.warning: A short grace lets fireball/TNT knockback count as speed.

parameters.label: Teleport grace
parameters.tooltip: Movement checks ignore a player for this long after a teleport (respawn, pearl, server correction).

parameters.label: Ice grace
parameters.tooltip: Speed-related checks ignore a player for this long after touching ice or packed ice.

parameters.label: Warm-up
parameters.tooltip: Players are observed for this long before any check judges them.

parameters.label: Swing → hurt window
parameters.tooltip: How many ticks may separate an attacker's swing from the victim's hurt animation for the hit to be attributed.

parameters.label: Settle delay
parameters.tooltip: Hits are evaluated after this delay so late position and rotation packets are included.

parameters.label: Latency compensation
parameters.tooltip: How far back the victim's positions are considered when measuring reach and aim. Covers the attacker's ping and entity interpolation.
parameters.warning: Low compensation measures against positions the attacker may never have seen; laggy players will look like they reach.

parameters.label: Candidate range
parameters.tooltip: Swinging players farther than this from the victim are not considered as the attacker.

parameters.label: Session journal
parameters.tooltip: Write every detection and its evidence to sessions/ as JSON lines.

parameters.label: Player history
parameters.tooltip: Remember players with evidence across sessions (name, sessions, detections, peak suspicion) in history/players.json.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.tooltip: Automated aiming and target selection

parameters.label: Sensitivity
parameters.tooltip: Adjusts thresholds and evidence requirements together. Relaxed favors certainty; Strict flags earlier at a higher false-positive risk. Editing any controlled value switches to Custom.

parameters.label: Alert threshold
parameters.tooltip: Confidence a player must reach before Vigil reports a detection.

parameters.label: Evidence required
parameters.tooltip: Number of separate observations needed inside the evidence window before a detection may fire. Prevents single outliers from flagging anyone.
parameters.warning: With a single observation allowed, one anomalous measurement can produce a detection.

parameters.label: Distinct indicators
parameters.tooltip: How many different kinds of evidence must agree before a detection may fire.

parameters.label: Confidence half-life
parameters.tooltip: Time for confidence to fall by half when no new evidence arrives. Longer values remember past behavior; shorter values forgive faster.

parameters.label: Evidence window
parameters.tooltip: How far back observations count toward the evidence requirement.

parameters.label: Alert cooldown
parameters.tooltip: Minimum time between two detections of this check for the same player.

parameters.label: Evidence gain
parameters.tooltip: Fraction of the remaining confidence headroom that one full-strength, weight-1 observation adds.

parameters.label: Hit outside view
parameters.tooltip: The attacker's aim was far from the victim's hitbox when the hit landed.
parameters.warning: Turning an indicator off removes that evidence source; detections will rely on the remaining indicators.

parameters.label: Hit outside view weight
parameters.tooltip: How strongly one observation from this indicator raises confidence, relative to other indicators.

parameters.label: Multi-target
parameters.tooltip: Two different players were hit within a few ticks at widely separated angles.
parameters.warning: Turning an indicator off removes that evidence source; detections will rely on the remaining indicators.

parameters.label: Multi-target weight
parameters.tooltip: How strongly one observation from this indicator raises confidence, relative to other indicators.

parameters.label: Snap to target
parameters.tooltip: A large rotation in the ticks before a hit that ends exactly on the target and stops.
parameters.warning: Turning an indicator off removes that evidence source; detections will rely on the remaining indicators.

parameters.label: Snap to target weight
parameters.tooltip: How strongly one observation from this indicator raises confidence, relative to other indicators.

parameters.label: Robotic tracking
parameters.tooltip: Aim stays locked onto a moving target with near-zero error for a sustained period.
parameters.warning: Turning an indicator off removes that evidence source; detections will rely on the remaining indicators.

parameters.label: Robotic tracking weight
parameters.tooltip: How strongly one observation from this indicator raises confidence, relative to other indicators.

parameters.label: Unambiguous hits only
parameters.tooltip: Only judge hits where exactly one swinging player could have caused the damage.
parameters.warning: Ambiguous hits can be attributed to the wrong player in crowded fights.

parameters.label: View angle limit
parameters.tooltip: How far outside the victim's hitbox the attacker's aim may be at the moment of a hit before it counts as evidence.

parameters.label: Multi-target window
parameters.tooltip: Two hits on different players within this many ticks are compared for multi-targeting.

parameters.label: Target separation
parameters.tooltip: Minimum angle between two victims (as seen by the attacker) for near-simultaneous hits to count.

parameters.label: Snap rotation
parameters.tooltip: Rotation within two ticks before a hit that qualifies as a snap.

parameters.label: Snap landing error
parameters.tooltip: A snap must end within this angle of the victim's center.

parameters.label: Tracking error limit
parameters.tooltip: Average aim error to the victim's center below which tracking is considered robotic. Rotation packets are 1.4° coarse, so perfect tracking reads as roughly 0.7°.

parameters.label: Target motion
parameters.tooltip: The victim must move across the attacker's view at least this fast for tracking to be judged.

parameters.label: Sampling
parameters.tooltip: Analyze a subset of ticks and only nearby players to reduce CPU usage in crowded lobbies.
parameters.warning: Sampling skips ticks: short behaviors (single bursts, brief hops) can be missed and detections arrive later.

parameters.label: Analyze every
parameters.tooltip: When sampling is on, each player is analyzed once every N ticks.

parameters.label: Radius
parameters.tooltip: When sampling is on, players farther than this from you are not analyzed.

parameters.label: Debug output
parameters.tooltip: Records the raw inputs of every evaluation into the Evidence Explorer debug log and detections.log.

parameters.label: Evidence window

parameters.label: Evidence gain

parameters.label: Fast flat bridge
parameters.tooltip: Placing blocks underfoot faster than backward walking allows.

parameters.label: Fast flat bridge weight

parameters.label: Look-down angle
parameters.tooltip: Minimum pitch while bridging.

parameters.label: Speed limit
parameters.tooltip: Average speed above which flat bridging counts. Walking backwards tops out at 0.216 b/tick.

parameters.label: Placements
parameters.tooltip: Blocks placed within one second.

parameters.label: Sampling
parameters.tooltip: Analyze a subset of ticks and only nearby players to reduce CPU usage in crowded lobbies.
parameters.warning: Sampling skips ticks: short behaviors (single bursts, brief hops) can be missed and detections arrive later.

parameters.label: Analyze every
parameters.tooltip: When sampling is on, each player is analyzed once every N ticks.

parameters.label: Radius
parameters.tooltip: When sampling is on, players farther than this from you are not analyzed.

parameters.label: Debug output
parameters.tooltip: Records the raw inputs of every evaluation into the Evidence Explorer debug log and detections.log.

parameters.label: Enabled

parameters.label: Sensitivity
parameters.tooltip: Adjusts thresholds and evidence requirements together. Relaxed favors certainty; Strict flags earlier at a higher false-positive risk. Editing any controlled value switches to Custom.

parameters.label: Alert threshold

parameters.label: Evidence required
parameters.tooltip: Number of separate observations needed inside the evidence window before a detection may fire. Prevents single outliers from flagging anyone.
parameters.warning: With a single observation allowed, one anomalous measurement can produce a detection.
